Quantum 1.26.2 was certified on 2026-09-05. It pins **nucleus v1.23.2**, **quark v1.10.1** and **orbit v1.8.25**, with 22 sibling modules.

A patch release of the suite after Quantum 1.26.1: nucleus goes from v1.23.1 to v1.23.2 (patch), orbit goes from v1.8.20 to v1.8.25 (patch) and quark stays at v1.10.1. 5 sibling modules change version.
